scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm --prefix cloudflare install && npm --prefix cloudflare run deploy
